name: NightAuditCloseConsole
tagline: Close the hotel business day in one app: checklist, no-shows, posting, balancing, exceptions and the flash report.
description: A complete night audit app for Power Apps and Power Pages: eight-step checklist with sign-off, guarantee-based no-show fees, room & tax posting, POS and settlement batch balancing, automatic exceptions, day close and a manager flash report (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, revenue, payments).
features: 8-step checklist with sign-off and override reasons
No-show fees by guarantee with waiver reason
Room & tax posting with comp-code rule
POS and settlement batch balancing with tolerance
Day close with ReportJson and business-date roll
Bulk actions, undo, search, filter, group, sort, paging
Phone layout with bottom bar and More sheet
Demo mode with a fictional 32-room hotel
react: 16.14.0 bundled, no platform library, no Fluent UI
controlType: standard (2 controls: NightAuditCloseConsole data set + NightAuditCloseConsolePortal field)
